selection.badware: Host anchors from uBlock uAssets badware.txt. Included when the rule has no options, or only doc/all plus an optional reason. Rules with domain=, to=, ipaddress=, or resource-type limits are omitted so Shield does not widen them. Tag doc = upstream $doc (document only). Tag all = whole-host anchor.
selection.tif: Every plain ||host^ anchor in HaGeZi TIF mini (no options, no path). The manual checker uses this full list. The extension uses a size-capped prefix; see apps/extension build.
selection.trackers: Plain ||host^ anchors from EasyPrivacy whose hostname matches a tracker-related token (track, pixel, analytic, doubleclick, metric, telemetry, beacon, and a short list of known tracker vendors). Not the full EasyPrivacy list. Not used as a malware verdict.
